name: IQKeyboardManager
description: Codeless drop-in universal library allows to prevent issues of keyboard sliding up and cover UITextField/UITextView. Neither need to write any code nor any setup required and much more.

latest_release.name: 8.0.3 Dependency updates and CocoaPods fixes
latest_release.body:
#### Improvements
- Removed obsolete iOS 13 availability checks throughout the codebase.
- Updated all SPM and CocoaPods dependency versions.

#### Bug fixes
- Fixed several CocoaPods compilation and podspec integration issues.
